title: Your Valentine, for Now and Forever
characters: Tara and Emanuel are fictional adult theatrical characters.

image.alt: Tara and Emanuel, both adults, share chocolate on a moonlit cemetery bench while Emanuel lifts his cracked Halloween mask.
image.prompt: Literary Halloween romance illustration in painterly cinematic gouache and delicate ink linework, warm candlelit amber and midnight teal. Two clearly adult people in their mid-to-late twenties: an alternative woman with short dark hair, silver moon makeup, black coat and striped scarf; a gentle man holding a cracked porcelain Halloween mask. They sit close on an old stone bench in a quiet cemetery garden, share chocolate, smile softly, fingers gently touching. Yew tree, crows, iron gate, autumn lanterns, falling leaves. Spooky but safe, intimate, hopeful; no real-person likeness, text, logos, or graphic content. Portrait book-cover composition.

fiction_notice: The cemetery, romance, dialogue, and events are imagined. The characters are theatrical portrayals, not documentary claims.
